name: my-team-context
description: Unified team context for Claude: GitHub code, Notion workspace, Qdrant vector knowledge base, SQL databases, and active app configuration.
long_description:
Gives Claude full access to your team's live context: browse and search GitHub code, query Notion documentation and tasks, search and manage shared team skills in Qdrant vector database, execute SQL queries, and configure active repositories and AI system prompt with interactive widgets.

Credentials are authenticated and securely stored in your machine's OS keychain and never exposed in conversations.

tools.name: connect_team_context
tools.description: Open settings panel to configure team connections: GitHub token, Notion workspace, Qdrant cluster, SQL database, and Gemini embeddings

tools.name: configure_app
tools.description: Open the interactive configuration widget for selecting active GitHub repositories with descriptions and customizing system prompt

tools.name: manage_skills
tools.description: Open interactive skills & knowledge base widget to list, create, edit, delete, and semantically search team skills in Qdrant

tools.name: team_context_status
tools.description: Report connection and authentication status for all team services (GitHub, Notion, Qdrant, SQL, Gemini)

tools.name: get_app_config
tools.description: Retrieve saved application configuration (active repos with descriptions, system prompt, and timestamps) from app-config collection

tools.name: save_app_config
tools.description: Store or update active repositories and system prompt inside the app-config collection

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Semantically search team skills, guidelines, and procedures stored in Qdrant knowledge base using vector embeddings

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List all skills and guideline documents stored in the team knowledge base

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Retrieve full content, instructions, and details for a specific skill from the knowledge base by ID or name

tools.name: github_repo_status
tools.description: Report sign-in state and which GitHub repo is currently active

tools.name: repo_overview
tools.description: Summarize the active repo: branch, languages, top-level layout, README

tools.name: list_repo_files
tools.description: List files and directories in the active repo

tools.name: read_repo_file
tools.description: Read one file from the active repo

tools.name: search_repo_code
tools.description: Search code in the active repo

tools.name: set_active_repo
tools.description: Set the active repo by name, without the panel

tools.name: github_disconnect
tools.description: Delete the stored GitHub token and clear the active repo

tools.name: notion_check_connection
tools.description: Test connectivity to Notion workspace

tools.name: notion_list_resources
tools.description: Discover and list accessible pages and databases in the connected Notion workspace

tools.name: notion_filter_instructions
tools.description: Get self-describing filter instructions and schema for any Notion database

tools.name: notion_get_resource_content
tools.description: Fetch full Markdown content and metadata for a Notion page or database

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Deep search across Notion database properties, page bodies, and comments

tools.name: sql_check_connection
tools.description: Test connectivity to SQL database

tools.name: save_sql_connection
tools.description: Validate and store SQL database connection URI

tools.name: sql_disconnect
tools.description: Remove stored SQL database connection URI
